name: Sakura (Tochigi, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Sakura city emblem in blue, pink and black: a blue disc with a white swirl and a pink cherry blossom, with the characters さくら市 at the lower fly.
history: Municipal flag of Sakura, a city in Tochigi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 28 March 2005.
